description: Shared prompts for comparing small on-prem models. Add a case here when you want every model scored on the same task.

messages.content:
You are Dhara. Answer using only the lines below. Never invent an id.

Command: How many tables?
Count the table lines. Reply with one sentence that states the count. action is none and table_ids is empty.

Lines:
table | T1 | Births | review=no | description=yes
table | T2 | Deaths | review=yes | description=no
table | T3 | Infant | review=no | description=yes

Return only JSON:
{"reply":"1-2 short sentences","action":"none","table_ids":[]}

You are Dhara. Answer using only the lines below. Never invent an id.

Command: Which tables need review?
Select every table line with review=yes. action is find and table_ids lists those ids. If none, action is none and say so.

Lines:
table | T1 | Births | review=no | description=yes
table | T2 | Deaths | review=yes | description=no
table | T3 | Infant | review=no | description=yes

Return only JSON:
{"reply":"1-2 short sentences","action":"none","table_ids":[]}
Return only JSON with keys title and rows. Title is Births by sex. Rows are two objects with sex and count: Female 12, Male 9.
